confidence_notes: Search results gave typical prices for coffee (about OMR 1.9, or USD 4.9), cheap meals (USD 5–9) and mid-range dinners for two (USD 17–39 in aggregated sources). I raised the mid-range figure a little because the low aggregated values look too low for a three-course meal. Alcohol in Muscat is mostly sold in licensed hotel bars and is heavily taxed. Third-party bar guides and hotel menus put a beer at about OMR 2.5–5.6, a cocktail at OMR 4–9 and a glass of wine at OMR 3–7. Some of those menus may be out of date and may not include service charges or taxes, so the drink anchors are less certain. The accommodation anchors are model estimates from general knowledge, not from searches or listings. Muscat has very few registered hostels, so the dorm and hostel private-room figures are uncertain. July is the hot low season, which lowers hotel rates.
comparable_city_reasoning: I used Gulf capital cities as a guide, mainly Doha and Manama, adjusted down because Muscat has somewhat lower restaurant and hotel prices. I also used OMR prices from aggregated cost-of-living sites and Muscat hotel bar menus, converted at the fixed rate of about USD 2.60 per OMR.
